label: MCP
scope: HTTP JSON-RPC discovery, tool listing/calls; legacy initialize lifecycle. Not a full conformance suite.

label: A2A
scope: JSONRPC messaging, task lookup/cancel and stream artifacts. REST, gRPC and push subscriptions are not exercised.

label: OpenAPI
scope: Swagger 2 / OpenAPI 3.0–3.2 structural and selected request/response schema changes. Composition, callbacks, webhooks, links and new 3.2 streaming semantics require manual review.

label: JSON Schema
scope: Ajv validation with formats and local references. Unknown keywords, remote references and unsupported dialects fail explicitly.

label: OAuth security BCP
scope: Authorization Code + PKCE S256, exact redirect matching, no password grant. Metadata checks do not validate an authorization server.

label: JWT security BCP
scope: Decoding does not verify authenticity. Verification must constrain algorithms, keys, issuer, audience, token purpose and time claims.

label: HTTP Problem Details
scope: Obsoletes RFC 7807; application/problem+json reference.

label: IANA HTTP status registry
scope: Canonical 413/418/422 names. 104 is temporary and expires 2026-11-13 unless extended; confirm the live registry.

label: IANA service names and ports
scope: Common ports are a curated selection, not an authoritative full registry or proof of which service is running.

label: UUID
scope: v3/v5 namespace-based UUIDs, v4 randomness, v7 millisecond timestamp and version inspection. UUIDs are not secrets.

label: W3C Trace Context
scope: Header syntax and v00 generation. Future-version extensions are only partially interpreted.

label: OpenAI models and prices
scope: Only rows with individual review dates have refreshed metadata. Historical rows are unverified. Local BPE/heuristics are not API billing counts.

label: Claude models and prices
scope: First-party standard text tier; long-context, caching, residency and batch rates differ.

label: Gemini models and prices
scope: Dated promotional rates and expiry shown per row; multimodal and storage charges differ.

label: Git ignore patterns
scope: Original stack/editor/OS starter patterns. Git precedence, negation and parent-directory exclusion rules apply; already tracked files remain tracked.

label: ULID
scope: 26-character Crockford Base32 encoding, timestamp inspection and page-session monotonic generation with overflow rejection.

label: Null MX
scope: Distinguishes explicit no-mail domains, ordinary MX, implicit A/AAAA fallback, NXDOMAIN and lookup failure. DNS does not establish mailbox deliverability.

label: PHP cURL
scope: Generated PHP uses CurlHandle lifetime cleanup rather than curl_close(), which is deprecated as of PHP 8.5. Actual local raw/multipart request fixtures pass.

label: RDAP service discovery
scope: Longest DNS-label suffix and IP-prefix matching, HTTPS registry endpoints and explicit missing-service errors. Domain/IP lookup records are retrieved at use time; registry privacy policies apply.

label: RDAP responses
scope: Domain/IP-network summaries, entities, events, statuses and nameservers. Optional/redacted fields are not treated as proof of ownership or mailbox availability.

label: WHATWG HTML
scope: HTML numeric references use full Unicode code points, U+FFFD for invalid values and C1 control mappings. Semicolons are required; named decoding supports this tool's listed entity subset.

label: CryptoJS compatibility
scope: Legacy AES-256-CBC passphrase compatibility and Keccak digest labels. No authenticated encryption or FIPS SHA-3 claim.

label: JSON Web Algorithms
scope: JWE GCM and CBC-HMAC, direct keys and AES-KW; JWS key sizes and JWK algorithm metadata. Published vectors cover supported modes.

label: JSON Web Signature
scope: UTF-8 compact signatures with an explicitly selected algorithm. Signature checks do not validate application claims.

label: X.509 certificates
scope: Browser-generated self-signed X.509 DER signatures, subject alternative names and matching keys. No public trust or complete PKIX validation claim.

label: OpenSSH key formats
scope: OpenSSH public wire blobs and unencrypted private-key files. Independent ssh-keygen fixtures validate supported algorithms and fingerprints.

label: WCAG contrast
scope: Opaque sRGB hex pairs, unrounded WCAG 2.2 text and non-text contrast thresholds; no whole-page accessibility or legal compliance claim.

label: YAML media type
scope: Curated MIME labels and extension hints. application/yaml follows RFC 9512; extensions and registry presence do not validate file contents.

label: TOON
scope: Two-space, comma-delimited TOON subset with strict counts and precision checks. Keyed tables, nested field groups and alternate delimiters are unsupported.

label: IANA IPv6 special-purpose registry
scope: Selected IPv6 prefixes, including documentation and dummy ranges. Registry classification does not establish reachability; address counts are full block sizes.

label: TLS 1.3
scope: RFC 9846 replaces RFC 8446. The reference separates publication maturity and replacement links from deployment advice; it does not test protocol conformance.
